features.name: Chat Interface
features.description: Provide a customer-facing interface for submitting support questions and viewing the conversation.

features.name: Chat API Integration
features.description: Connect the frontend to the Phase 1 POST /chat API.
acceptance_criteria: Frontend sends the expected request payload
Frontend does not implement backend business logic

features.name: Source Citation Display
features.description: Display source information returned by the backend.
acceptance_criteria: No source is fabricated when the API returns none

features.name: Escalation Presentation
features.description: Clearly present responses that require human assistance.
acceptance_criteria: The customer is told that human assistance is required
The frontend does not claim a ticket or human review unless supplied by the API

features.name: Loading and Submission State
features.description: Provide clear feedback while a chat request is being processed.
acceptance_criteria: Loading state is displayed during an API request
Duplicate submissions are prevented while pending
UI returns to an interactive state after completion

features.name: API Error Handling
features.description: Handle failed chat requests without exposing implementation details.
acceptance_criteria: Raw stack traces are not displayed

features.name: Responsive and Accessible UI
features.description: Make the support interface usable across common screen sizes and interaction methods.
acceptance_criteria: Interface remains usable on mobile-sized screens
Interface remains usable on desktop-sized screens
Loading and error states are perceivable
